```{r}
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("tidyverse")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
# data cleaning

# FIPS = County FPIS code
# SVPREC = unique precinct ID
# CDDIST = congresional district number
# ADDIST = state assembly district number
# SDDIST = state senate district number
# BEDIST = board of equalization District number 

# TOTRE = Total regisitered voters in the precinct 
# DEMREG, REPREG = Registered voters by political party affilation 
# TOTVOTE = TOtal Ballots cast
# ABSVOTE = Toal Absentee Ballots Cast 

# CNGDEM01 = Congresional Race, Democraat Candidate 01 (votes for the first listed democractic candidate in the congressional race)

#CNGREP01 = Congressional Race, Republican, Candidate 01 

# PRSDEM01 PRS(President) DEMocrat candidaete 01 (votes for the democratic presidential candidate)

# PR_32_N, PR_32_Y = PRoposition 32, No or Yes (votes for and against prop 32)


g24_sov <- read.csv("/Users/fernando/Desktop/gerrymandering-Fernando-Cal/data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

# check data types for the following columns 
typeof(g24_sov$CNGDEM01) # character
typeof(g24_sov$CNGDEM02) # character 
typeof(g24_sov$CNGIND01) # character 
typeof(g24_sov$CNGREP01	) # character 
typeof(g24_sov$CNGREP02	) # character 

g24_sov <- g24_sov |>
    mutate_at(c("CNGDEM01", "CNGDEM02", "CNGIND01", "CNGREP01", "CNGREP02"), as.numeric)



```
